Search Everywhere Architecture

Built for Google Search, answer engines and AI-assisted discovery.

Search behaviour is changing, but the foundation remains useful content, technical clarity, crawlable pages and strong entity signals. We connect those fundamentals across the following layers.

SEO

Search Engine Optimisation

Technical structure, headings, metadata, internal linking, page intent, performance and content designed to help search engines understand the site.

AEO

Answer Engine Optimisation

Direct answers, concise definitions, FAQs, comparisons and structured sections that make important information easier to extract and present.

GEO

Generative Engine Optimisation

Entity consistency, topical depth, factual clarity and citation-worthy content planned for generative search systems. Inclusion is never guaranteed.

LLM

LLM Readability

Accessible HTML, explicit relationships, descriptive language and reliable business facts that help machine systems interpret the organisation and its services.

AI

AI & Featured Snippets

Question-led sections, summary blocks, schema and clear source information designed to improve eligibility for snippets, AI Overviews and similar experiences.

✓
Guideline-led, not shortcut-led.We do not use hidden text, doorway pages, scraped copy or ranking guarantees. Content is written for users first and supported by clean technical implementation, structured data and transparent claims.
